source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units that have this ability, other than **MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units, gain three abilities:

- **Encircling Jaws**: under the **[assault doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, the unit adds 1 to its Charge rolls and Advance rolls.
- **Hunter’s Eye**: under the **[devastator doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, its ranged attacks may re-roll a [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) of 1.
- **Ferocious Strike**: under the **[tactical doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)**, its attacks targeting enemy units 'with 9"' of it get **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)**.

Your **LOGAN GRIMNAR** units gain **Howling Onslaught**, usable by your army once per battle in your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase): your **ADEPTUS ASTARTES MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** units then also benefit from **Master of Wolves** until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) starts.

**Restrictions**: **SPACE WOLVES** units are allowed in your army, but **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** units from any other Chapter are not.

Ferocious Strike's range is printed as 'with 9"', not 'within 9"', so which enemy units it covers is open.
